Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning vending machines in work places.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to display requirements for vending machineslocated in places of employment; and adding a new chapter to Title 19RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If an employer receives any proceedsfrom sales of items in a vending machine used primarily by thatemployer's employees, then the employer or the vending machine operatormust post a clear and conspicuous statement indicating the amount orpercentage of receipts paid to the employer. (2) For purposes of this section: (a) "Employer" means any person, association, partnership, orprivate or public corporation, or their agents, who employ or exercisecontrol over wages, hours, or working conditions of one or moreemployees. (b) "Vending machine" means any coinoperated machine that sells orprovides food, tobacco, sundries, or other retail merchandise orservice. (c) "Vending machine operator" means any person who owns, operates, p. 1 HB 2203or maintains one or more vending machines in, at, or upon premisesowned or occupied by any other person.
Section 1 of this act constitutes a newchapter in Title 19 RCW.
